grounds: Every required criterion for a minor release passes and no veto condition is met, so the release proceeds. It proceeds as SHAPE rather than ALLOW because material limitations remain that a reader must be told about rather than left to discover: no independent archival identifier, no third-party evaluation of any claim, no external security review, and a coordinate reorganisation shipping as explicitly unratified. RELEASE-GOVERNANCE.md §1 reserves SHAPE for exactly this — criteria pass, important non-blocking limitations remain, proceed with explicit caveats.
why_not_allow: ALLOW asserts that nothing needs qualifying. Four things do. Calling this ALLOW would make the release record less informative than the release notes it accompanies, which would invert the point of having both.

narrowing_applied: Status ships as EXPERIMENTAL, not stable. The contract may change without a major bump before v1.0.0 (VERSIONING.md §3)
No DOI. The release is citable by signed tag and content hash, not by an archival identifier

The observed-record capability exists in the schema and is deliberately unexercised, because publishing an analysis of a project that cannot answer back is the failure mode the right of reply exists to prevent
CONFORMANCE_TESTED is unreachable by construction — no conformance suites exist, so no project can truthfully claim that rung
LAYERS.md ships marked PROPOSED, NOT RATIFIED, NOT IMPLEMENTED. The schema still carries the older single-vector shape
Calibration cases and domain profiles ship as prose analyses, never as registry records

limitations_disclosed: Automation recommended ALLOW — the release.yml gate job passed every required check. The human determination is SHAPE, because passing checks is not the same as having nothing to disclose.
That person is the author of every document, schema and tool in the release, and the maintainer of all three registered records.

RELEASE-GOVERNANCE.md §2 requires that automation may recommend but not publish. That separation held procedurally — the workflow produced a draft and a human decided — but it is weak in substance when the recommender and the decider share an author.
This is the same limitation OTCS-0000 disclosed about its own ratification. It is recorded rather than resolved, because it cannot be resolved from inside a single-maintainer project.

review.reason: Every unmet criterion above is unmet for the same reason: nobody outside the project has used it yet. A second participant makes four of them testable at once.
